_comment: Copy the shape below into positions.json (which is gitignored). Keys are coin ids from MEME_WATCH in src/data/providers.js (e.g. cate, pons, bluechip, ai). Each coin holds a list of buys; each buy = { amount: USD invested, mcap: market cap at entry in USD }. You may use "price" instead of "mcap". Multiple buys are dollar-weighted into one average entry. Easiest way to add a buy: node record-buy.js <coinId> <amountUSD> [entryMcap]
